name: io.github.align-software-company/opensolar-mcp
title: OpenSolar MCP
description: Unofficial, self-hosted MCP server for the documented OpenSolar API.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSOLAR_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile: agent (curated default) or full (every registered tool)

environmentVariables.name: OPENSOLAR_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Hide every tool that can change OpenSolar data

environmentVariables.name: OPENSOLAR_PLAN
environmentVariables.description: OpenSolar access plan; api_access hides tools that need Raw Data API Access

environmentVariables.name: OPENSOLAR_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets that replace the profile's tool selection

environmentVariables.name: OPENSOLAR_UPLOAD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory that create_private_file may read from; uploads stay disabled when unset
